candidates.audience: everyone first; then new vs returning visitors
candidates.why: the first thing a visitor reads, with static words: a copy slot lets an agent test headline, subhead and button label as plain text, and swap the hero image (an upload or URL with alt text)
candidates.mark: selector #top (already unique); inside it, put each field's words in an element marked data-prb-field="" (headline, subhead, cta_label); mark the data-prb-field="hero_image"; this is the script tag's markup (no component exists for this framework), and it acts on server-rendered markup only

candidates.audience: everyone; the order is learned from visitor features
